description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Recent TWAP slice fills sampled from Hyperliquid's official public info API (recentTrades with a zero hash). Research data, not investment advice. Not a complete book of every open TWAP; use hl_twap for one wallet. Params coin, limit. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON TWAP slice fills from Hyperliquid's public info API (not a complete book of every open TWAP).

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional coin or HIP-3 market filter. Format: a Hyperliquid coin name. Example: BTC. Another example already in the tool text: xyz:GOLD. Omit for every coin in the sample.

limit.description: Maximum fills to return. Format: integer. Example: 50. Default: 50. Maximum: 200, as the existing tool text states.

name: hl_twaps
title: Live Hyperliquid TWAP slice fills ($0.005)
